programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - OKIDO in Bloom
programme.desc: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. The sky is full of big grey rain clouds in the real world. Messy watches his sandcastle outside get washed away by the pouring rain. Why does it have to rain? He com

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Honestly, Monty
programme.desc: Monty becomes nervous when he breaks Jeanie's project and doesn't know whether to tell her. He soon learns that you should always be honest.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Make Shadow Puppets
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are ready to watch a Captain Chloe film. Suddenly, the lights go out!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time for a Dance Class
programme.desc: JoJo is excited to go dancing and to help her friend Henry at his first dance class.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Mountain Mints
programme.desc: Scarf Lady takes Sarah and Duck on trip up the mountains.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Fluff Bread
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck help the baker bake Shoku-pan, a light and fluffy type of Japanese bread.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - Thomas' Not So Lucky Day
programme.desc: It's Friday the 13th in Italy and Thomas tries to improve his luck by following Lorenzo and Beppe's advice on superstitions.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Keepy Uppy
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum are enjoying playing Keepy-Uppy around the house, when Dad joins in and the game becomes the ultimate test of skill.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Daddy Robot
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo don't want to tidy the playroom, so they get Daddy Robot to do it. But when Bluey takes things too far, Daddy Robot malfunctions!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Shadowlands
programme.desc: On a picnic in the park, Bluey and her friends play Shadowlands. Coco keeps taking shortcuts so Bluey has to show her that following the rules can make the game more fun.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Three Peas in a Pod
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team face a trio of Evil Peas when Mummy Pea and Daddy Pea come to visit Evil Pea. They vow to help her take over the supermarket once and for all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Philosophy Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels think about life's big questions, and gain their Philosophy badges.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Sharing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels bake a pie and learn how to share by dividing things between them

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Cappadocia, Turkey
programme.desc: A game of hide and seek threatens to topple the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia in Turkey.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Maasai Mara National Park, Kenya
programme.desc: The team roars into action as Glitch tries to take a selfie with a lion in the Maasai Mara.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Gobi Desert, Mongolia
programme.desc: Glitch's giant drill causes a dino-disaster for the team's fossil hunt in the Gobi Desert.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Je'naé's Jamaican Saltfish and Cabbage
programme.desc: Je'naé is cooking her favourite meal of Jamaican saltfish and cabbage. Her mum has even cooked some tasty Jamaican dumplings and rice to eat with the fish for her friends.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Lar Gibbons
programme.desc: Andy encounters some baby Lar Gibbons in Thailand that appear to be flying as they swing through the rainforest.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S8) - The Big Book of Pirate World Records
programme.desc: Captain Captain wants to get Sandy, Seaweed and herself into the Big Book of Pirate World Records and sets the pirates the task of trying to break a record to get their names in the book!

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Mystery Egg
programme.desc: Krash is intrigued by a shining golden egg.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Mums and Dads
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Hide and Seek
programme.desc: It's time for a family game of hide and seek. Everyone hides, while Bluey counts to twenty, but will she be able to stay focused on the game and not get distracted by all her toys.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Camping
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli Alone
programme.desc: Supertato is out chasing a milkshake robot and leaves Broccoli in charge of Tato Tower. Evil Pea tries to take over the tower, but Broccoli puts on a great defence.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Sibling Badge
programme.desc: Roly reveals he's expecting a new baby brother or sister, and the Squirrels have questions.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: My Dream Boat
programme.desc: This is a story about the complicated love relationships between a group of young friends who are entangled in a web of love and emotions.

programme.title: Brothers from the Walled City
programme.desc: Two orphaned brothers growing up in Kowloon's Walled City - the place where people are forced to live with indecent businesses of sex, gambling and drugs controlled by triads - take very different life paths. Chin works at a cabaret but keeps away from sins, while Kang is drawn to the sleazy underworld. Are their destinies shaped by the "walls"?

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: A young business man marries a pretty and much sought-after young bride, not knowing that she carries the spirit of a girl raped by her uncle and murdered along with her parents. Justice must be done, and it ain't pretty!

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demon's clutches.

programme.title: Killer Darts
programme.desc: A group of bandits raided the village where dart master Liu lives and killed his wife. While hunting them down, Liu's disciple kills a farmer and his wife when she refuses his advances, leading Liu to adopt their orphaned daughter and raises her with his son. Years later, the daughter meets a man with the bandits and is tricked to go against Liu.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Rendezvous With Death
programme.desc: Sun Chung had been recognized as an expert comedy and crime thriller director, but he was to gain even greater acclaim for his soulful, powerful, intelligent, and beautifully-made martial arts epics. This stands alongside The Deadly Breaking Sword and The Kung-fu Instructor as one of his very best.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love...

programme.title: 7-Man Army
programme.desc: This iconoclastic film retells the legend of seven Chinese patriots, who sacrificed their lives to defend against 20,000 Japanese soldiers and 50 tanks for 5 days, at a strategic key point of the Great Wall known as Pa Tou Lou Tzu.

programme.title: The Love Eterne
programme.desc: Ying Tai disguises herself as a boy to go to school and falls hopelessly in love with her classmate, Shan Bo. After Shan Bo realizes her true identity, he proposes marriage to Ying Tai. However, they are kept apart as she is engaged to another man. Knowing Shan Bo died in despair, Ying Tai is in deep sorrow and kills herself at his grave.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: The devilish residents of the Village of Tigers, led by Hu Jiao, plan to kill Lo Hong Shun, otherwise known as the heroic Sword of the Southern Sky. Hu Jiao sees a way to use the righteousness of the honorable Ba family to help him kill the hero Lo by turning them against him. Will good prevail over evil?

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage. A heartless tycoon plans to take over the orphanage for its land but has to deal with Seventh Sister's magical powers as she aims to protect it from falling into his hands!

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong raise the son of his sworn brother Yang Kang and named him Yang Guo. To prevent Yang Guo from taking revenge for his father's death, Huang Rong bans him from learning martial arts. Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.title: The Happy Trio
programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

programme.title: Pursuit of Vengeance
programme.desc: Kung Fu legend Ti Lung stars in the action movie as Fu Xue Hong, embarking on a epic journey of revenge for his father.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic "The Water Margin", and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Comparing to the director's previous Hex. This time, however, the stakes are even higher and the gruesome goings-on even more memorable. It all starts when a noble police detective starts investigating a child killer's claims of an evil spell, then it doesn't let up until the final, bloated, maggot-ridden cadaver falls.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughter’s company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: In Cycle
programme.desc: A seemingly happy couple who loves diving come to a deserted island for a diving vacation, which is part of the husband’s plan to murder his wife. His conspiracy however, is intervened by a series of bizarre events on the island. Can the couple eventually escape from the enigmatic ocean?

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip’s boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim’s sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist’s drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi’s husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Fei’s possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: No. 82 Haunted House
programme.desc: The eldest son of the Mu family dies suddenly on the eve of his wedding. To rest his soul, a maid Xiao Die is made to marry and then buried alive with him. Since then, Mu's house is haunted by a series of terrifying incidents, and the family's secrets are gradually unveiled when Mu’s youngest daughter return home from abroad with her boyfriend.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Midnight Ruins
programme.desc: Fallen painter Cheng Zihao is asked to investigate the strange events that occurred during the rehearsal of a play "Song of the Night" by an old friend. This play was rehearsed by them in the past, and has brought him many pains and nightmares. As Cheng Zihao uncovers the truth, he is shocked by the same story of love and hate after so many years...

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Global Business
programme.desc: The flagship business program of CGTN’s English language service. The program offers in-depth analysis of the latest economic data, business trends and market moving policies, zooming in on how all this affects ordinary people. With separate editions out of Asia, Europe, Africa and the Americas, Global Business features analysts and news-makers supported through a global network of correspondents. Global Business shows you what's moving markets in both developed and emerging economies.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Wingmen
programme.desc: When unexpected guests arrive bringing AAARRRGGHHs past and illness to light Jim finds himself competing in a terrifying game of Pyrobligst.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Angor Management
programme.desc: Jim and Strickler team up to bring down Angor Rot Meanwhile the Gnome returns with important information regarding Baby Enrique.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Eye of the Sahara
programme.desc: The kids manage to make it through the crazy storm and build gliders out of parts of the fallen spy plane to travel closer to Cleve’s base and save Nowhere and Gary. Cleve sees the kids on his satellite feeds and sends a bunch of drones to take them out. During the aerial battle, Cisco splits off and leads the drones away so that the rest of the crew can escape, causing him to be lost alone in the giant storm

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - RoboCleve
programme.desc: The kids hatch a plan to take down Cleve and rescue Ms. Nowhere and Gary. Meanwhile, despite interference from Ziri, Cleve successfully begins to launch his satellites into space, which will allow him to use his weather machine to destroy Earth’s major cities and transform the Sahara into the only oasis. In order to stop the satellites, the team engages in an all-out battle against Cleve, Matsuo, and Rafaela.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Sirocco Fire Explosion
programme.desc: Cleve has the team surrounded - is this the end? Suddenly, Cisco bursts in to save the day, along with all of the friends the team has made along the way in the Sahara. Working together, they manage to stop Cleve’s missiles and defeat Rafaela and Matsuo. But before they get a chance to celebrate, a giant fire tornado tears its way through the Sahara destroying everything in its path. Tony decides to make one last daring attempt in order to save the day.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Marshtato Fairy Do the Biggie
programme.desc: On the foggiest night of the year, the Marshtato Fairy magically delivers marshtatos to Troll Village, which every Troll loves and celebrates- except for Branch, who doesn’t think the Marshtato Fairy exists. When Poppy encourages him to believe, Branch set out to prove Poppy wrong. When Biggie accidentally invents a dance craze, he realizes how much he enjoys being the center of attention. Biggie and Guy set out to create another Troll dance sensation in order to keep Biggie’s big moment going.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Super Amazing And Fun Cousin Julian
programme.desc: Luckys buttons are pushed when her seemingly perfect cousin Julian comes to visit but reveals himself to be a junior con man

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Knights of Light (Part 1)
programme.desc: With Allura as their guide, the Paladins embark on a dangerous journey into Honerva’s mindspace to uncover her final plan.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - A Bed For Raffi
programme.desc: Apartment renovations find Raffi in search of a place to stay for a few days. The popular, even-keeled Raffi turns out to be an impossible houseguest, quickly burning bridges with his podmates. In the end, not even Birch can stand the thought of another night having to house Pod 4's resident Mr. Perfect.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Back To The Stone Age
programme.desc: When the janitor is the subject of ridicule in a widely spread cell phone picture, Principal Lemmon bans all electronic devices. Soon Cosmos High's extra controlling head honcho is faced with the decision whether or not life can go on without her beloved walkie-talkie. As technological abilities plunge, tempers escalate and a student revolt ensues.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - The Costume Party
programme.desc: Grounded from attending Dave's costume party, Birch sneaks out with the help of her podmates. A series of unforeseen circumstances sees the evening turn into an Odyssey for the podmates. And while it's not exactly what they planned, it's not all bad until they discover Birch has to end the evening by "breaking-in" to her own house.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Integrity Insmegrity
programme.desc: Creative integrity gets a workout when Liam and Birch's Manga ends up in the pages of the local alternative magazine. Soon publisher pressure has Liam and Birch questioning their creative vision and how much they're willing to compromise. Of course, the two can't possibly be on the same side at the same time.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Shadows
programme.desc: Webby is clearing out her web. Fifi takes all the unwanted objects home and uses them to play a brilliant game of shadow puppets, a perfect game to play on a rainy day!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Buttercup Bad Wolf
programme.desc: The twins are playing "The Three Little Pigs". Buttercup is enjoying her role as the big bad wolf rather too much and scares poor Daisy. Will Buttercup realise how upset her sister is?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Count On Fifi
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble deliver lots of delicious honey to Poppy's stall. They lose a pot on the way and there isn't enough to go round. Can they find the missing pot, or will Stingo have to go without his honey for tea?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Poppy The Line Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Poppy is having a line dancing party, but none of the other flowertots know how to do it. Will any of them learn to dance in time or will Poppy have to cancel the party?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - King Stingo
programme.desc: Aunt Tulip has lost Grubby again. When Stingo finds him, he asks to be made King as a reward. It isn't long before he has gone too far and the tots are all fed up with his demands. Can Fifi get life in the garden back to normal?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Hide And Seek
programme.desc: The tots are playing hide and seek and the winner will get Fifi's delicious jam tarts. Who will win, Stingo and Slugsy are sure it will be them!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - My Friend Fifi
programme.desc: Fifi and Bumble fall out in a big way after Fifi doesn't show up to the picnic they are supposed to have together. How strange that Stingo is trying to get them to be friends again, or is it?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Diggly's Big Adventure
programme.desc: Diggly is bored of life on his compost heap and wants to see round the rest of the garden. Fifi offers to give him a guided tour. Diggly gets lost, how will he get home?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Babies
programme.desc: After noticing all the great compliments Mother receives on account of adorable baby William, Olivia finds herself some babies of her own: her cat Edwin and her dog Perry. Being a mum is tougher than it seems, but when Mother asks Olivia to watch William for a minute, her new skills come in handy.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia's Pirate Treasure
programme.desc: When Olivia and her family go to the beach, Olivia finds what she thinks is a pearl-making oyster. She enlists Ian and Julian to help her find more, imagining that they're pirates in search of buried treasure. In reality, Father explains that they've actually found clams: no pearls inside, but great for a clambake!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Crash Course
programme.desc: Burple and Winger each injure a wing while they're with Dak, and only teamwork can get them home. At the roost, Cutter gets stuck in a puddle of goo.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Trolly Tales 2 Rainbowmageddon
programme.desc: The Trolls try to entertain and win over Archer Pastry with a series of Troll storiesWhen a rainbow over Troll Village begins to experience a catastrophic breakdown, Cloud Guy arrives in the village to offer his assistance

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S1 - Coop, Where's My Guy? Fluffleberry Quest
programme.desc: When Cooper loses Guy Diamond in Troll Forest, Poppy and Branch accompany him as he retraces his steps Poppy sets out to recreate the recipe of Branch's favorite dessert at any cost

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Only The Lucky Survive Shar-Squad
programme.desc: Tip tricks Oh into thinking he's invincible to convince him to go on a dangerous adventureSharzod takes revenge when she loses her squad to her arch-rival Fance

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S2 - Big Bad Love The Milk Job
programme.desc: When Tip and Oh bring Fox and Pom Pom together, the baddies get badderWhen Oh agrees to be Donny's wingman for a job, Donny introduces him to a shady underworld

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Drillipedes
programme.desc: With the Trux in need of repairs, the Tools try a new tunnel route to get parts. But on the way, they discover dangerous Drillipedes!

programme.title: Dinotrux S3 - Part Kart
programme.desc: The Trux build a mobile "part kart" for repairs out on the road, which comes in handy when Skya gets stranded with a Trux that needs help fast.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Spinny Water Kelp's Song
programme.desc: Kelp and his underwater friends race around an obstacle course, but Cruz gets sucked into a whirlpool. As each of them try to rescue him, they are sucked in! Kelp saves them all using his unicorn spark to create bubbles he attaches to seaweed. Kelp helps his unicorn friends create music with their horns and pieces of nature. Ollie is embarrassed by the sound of his horn.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s "fun-crastinating" puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Pupcakes \ Stink or Swim
programme.desc: When Tag discovers that Scooch is a great baker, she encourages him to start a pupcake stand. But when Tag rounds up more customers than Scooch is prepared to handle, Scooch can’t keep up with the demand. \ Tag and Scooch’s race to pick up the most trash on Pawston Beach is thwarted by Frank and Beans, who just want to make more of a mess.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - A Ball-For-All
programme.desc: It's Ball-entine’s Day, the day when the dogs of Pawston show their affection for each other by exchanging balls. But unfortunately, the town is fresh out, so Tag and Scooch set sail for Ball Island. \ If Tag and Scooch want to leave Ball Island with the balls they chose for their family, they must earn them by proving themselves ball-worthy, through a series of challenges from The Fetcher.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Photo Day Disaster The Eightful Eight
programme.desc: When Rodney heads to the Community Center for Junior Security Cadet picture day, TZG secretly helps him stay neat and clean for the photo shoot. When Luis worries about his first ever math test, TZG secretly helps steady his nerves.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Robo-Dog Day Afternoon Spoiler Alert
programme.desc: New girl in town Felicia shows off her robo-dog but it runs out of control, and TZG must secretly stop the barking bot from wreaking havoc. When Lula starts gathering birthday wishes from folks around town, TZG secretly keeps her surprise party under wraps.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tree Troubles Missing Pieces
programme.desc: When Marcus brings home the class tree sapling for the weekend, the Dew Drops see it starting to wilt and must cheer the sapling up, so Marcus can make sure to plant it for his class. When Athena accidentally breaks Lola's nature sculpture, the Dew Drops must go on a scavenger hunt to replace the missing pieces.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Ticket Trail Flying Solo
programme.desc: Lola, Dylan and Cassie have tickets to the carnival, but when Dylan loses his ticket, the Dew Drops set out to find it. When Phoebe accidentally gets tossed into Nicholas' diaper bag before a trip to the park, Phoebe has to help a baby bird, while Eden and Athena must help Marcus rehearse for his big concert.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - What Screams May Come Grunt Anything
programme.desc: Eep joins the Scream-Leading team and starts picking up characteristics of her coach, Meep, much to Ugga's chagrinMeep kicks Snoot out of the cave for not being a brave hunter. The Croods reluctantly take Snoot in and try to make him into a hunter to get him out of their home.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S1 - There Will Be Eggs I Think We're Alone Meow

programme.desc: On a search for Dagur's dad, Hiccup and Dagur encounter vicious Grim Gnashers, and Tuff's search for a missing Chicken leads him to discover she has a second family

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Becoming Part 2
programme.desc: Jim warms up to the idea of being the Trollhunter until he faces Bular, who is determined to destroy him, so he seeks help in Blinky and AAARRRGGHH!!

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Wherefore Art Thou Trollhunter?
programme.desc: Jim is not welcomed by the Trolls as their new Trollhunter, and he suffers a humiliating defeat at the hands of Draal

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Wherefore Art Thou Trollhunter?
programme.desc: Jim is not welcomed by the Trolls as their new Trollhunter, and he suffers a humiliating defeat at the hands of Draal

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Gnome Your Enemy
programme.desc: Jim undertakes his first Trollhunting mission by starting small: he must shrink down to eight inches tall to apprehend a mischievous gnome.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Enter SH1FT3R
programme.desc: Tony goes head-to-head with SH1FT3R’s main recruiter Layla Gray in a death-defying spy race through LA Tunnels, parking lots and construction sites. Tony’s awesome driving impresses Shashi Dhar (the head of SH1FT3R and the person Ms. Nowhere wants them to investigate), and after Tony and his crew pull a heist on a big rig full of energy drinks for Shashi, they’re officially accepted into the circuit.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - Ghost Town Grand Prix
programme.desc: Tony races against Shashi and Layla through a Northern California ghost town, but Shashi and Layla are using the race as a cover for a heist on a billionaire’s train. Tony and his team are introduced to the other cool SH1FT3R racers, and while they can’t stop the heist without blowing their cover, they do manage to get a tracker on the train car Shashi and Layla stole.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Owl Job
programme.desc: Shashi sends Tony and Layla to steal weapons codes from a Russian oligarch, while Margaret "Echo" Pearl, Cisco and Frostee use Shashi’s absence to sneak into Shashi’s Cliffside mansion to investigate. Ms. Nowhere tells the team to look for the "keys" in Shashi’s mansion, but all they find are a couple of awesome super-cars.

programme.title: Trolls: The Beat Goes On! S2 - Chummy Sparklestone Giggleyum
programme.desc: When the Funtime Factory stops producing one of their frosting flavors, Poppy sets out to create a replacement. But is her new flavor, Giggleyum too delicious?During a Troll mystery party, Cooper has the role of detective. But when the party is over, Detective Cooper - now "Chummy Sparklestone" - refuses to break character, and he’s causing problems around the village!

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: When Miradero's Christmas presents are delayed and snow isn't falling, Lucky and her friends decide it's up to them to bring the Christmas spirit to Miradero.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S3 - Uncharted Regions
programme.desc: As Honerva attempts to continues to put her plan in motion the Voltron Coalitions splits up to stop her. With success within reach Honerva unleashes her deadliest mech yet.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Skate Club
programme.desc: Sandra insists on breaking the gender barrier of a "boys only" skateboard race. But the race is one with a history for being incredibly dangerous. Will Sandra let Liam "save" her or will she save her reputation as the coolest sk8terchick at Cosmos High?

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Pinged And Ponged
programme.desc: A little white lie told to his ping-pong loving grandmother forces Raffi to actually try out for the team when they make the finals. Grandma is keen to see her favourite grandson play her favourite sport and he's not about to let her down. It soon becomes apparent that normally athletic Raffi is all thumbs when it comes to what team captain Antoine pretentiously refers to as table tennis.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Love Is In The Air
programme.desc: Spring has sprung and love is in the air at Cosmos High. When the other pods pressure Sandra and Raffi to couple-up, lovelorn Birch and Liam decide to take matters into their own hands ensuring that the reluctant pair don't end up together.

programme.title: My Life Me S1 - Cyranette
programme.desc: A cute guy into comics mistakes Birch's artwork as Sandra's comic. When the ruse is revealed, he falls for Birch. Sandra's ire rises, but both girls ultimately find out they've got a High School Lothario on their hands and reveal him to the sisterhood of Cosmos High.

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Poppy's Ice Cream Show
programme.desc: All the tots are picking fruit so Poppy can use it to make her famous ice cream. Stingo thinks he has come up with a much better plan to get hold of some ice cream without having to pick anything… will it work?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S3 - Painting Practice
programme.desc: Fifi wants to repaint her kitchen but Poppy has run out of paint. Can anybody else come up with an idea to brighten up her walls?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Pirate Primrose
programme.desc: The tots are playing at pirates, all except Primrose, who is being a princess, naturally. But guess which tot has the best pirating skills when they are needed

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Primrose Loses It
programme.desc: Primrose has broken her new necklace and lost the beads. She is unconsolable. Violet holds a make and do party to replace the necklace

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Dr Webby
programme.desc: Bumble's sneezing has got so bad, it is keeping everyone awake at night. Webby gives Fifi a recipe for a cure for sneezes… will it work?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Make Room For Fifi
programme.desc: There is a horrid smell in Fifi's garden. Fifi goes to stay with Primrose and Violet while they try and work out where the smell is coming from. What could be causing it?

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Slugsy's Song
programme.desc: Slugsy has found something really special. Only Primrose can be persuaded to go and see it with him. Even she is surprised by what she sees!

programme.title: Fifi and the Flowertots S2 - Stingo's Bridge
programme.desc: Webby has told Pip the story of the 3 Billy Goats Gruff. Soon a troll takes up residence under the bridge in the garden and demands food payment every time the tots cross. Can Fifi get to the bottom of the mystery?

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia And The Family Photo
programme.desc: Mother is determined to take the perfect family Christmas photo - in the middle of the summer. With the help of a snow machine, Olivia takes it upon herself to bring a little Christmas spirit to the photograph, and to Francine's backyard beach party next door.

programme.title: Olivia S1 - Olivia Goes Camping
programme.desc: Francine comes along reluctantly on Olivia's family camping trip, and Olivia can't believe that anyone could be so unprepared for life in the great outdoors. But with a little hiking, bug-catching, and marshmallow roasting, Olivia is sure she can transform Francine from a novice to an expert camper.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Grumblegard, Part 1
programme.desc: While the others care for baby dragons at the roost, Dak, Winger, Burple and Aggro come face-to-face with a grumpy old dragon on a dangerous island.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Turf War
programme.desc: It's a turf war when Bounce House Bruiser Baby encroaches on Delivery Baby's tricycle park! Tina attempts to befriend Bruiser in order to woo her back to the bounce house, but naughty behavior is the only language Bruiser understands. Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Terrifying Perilous Misfortune of the T.P. Mummy
programme.desc: After George and Harold T.P. the entire school with toilet paper, they are forced to flush it all down the toilet causing a giant explosion that turns the French teacher into the T.P. Mummy

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Squishy Predicament of Stanley Peet's Stinky Pits
programme.desc: When George and Harold want to win the school Avocadgrow contest, they accidentally turn their science teacher into a giant avocado monster

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Celestial Vault
programme.desc: Shashi stages a race up the privately-owned Mount Zebulon, and he invites Tony, Cisco, and Margaret "Echo" Pearl to participate. The crew soon discovers that Shashi is using the race to steal another super-car (this time from space!) - and he knows that Tony is working with the feds.

programme.title: Fast & Furious: Spy Racers S1 - The Final Key
programme.desc: Ms. Nowhere tells the kids that the failed mission is over, but Tony isn’t ready to give up, and he’s determined to rescue Frostee. The crew goes rogue by deciding to steal the final key from Shashi and trade it for their friend.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Dragon Knight S2 - The Bog-ey Man of Festermouth
programme.desc: There is more epic action and intrigue as Po and the Dragon Knights continue their quest to destroy the Tianshang weapons, but find themselves in treacherous waters when they are captured by pirates, one of which is out for revenge against Mr. Ping! The adventures lead them to London, where they are wanted by the Knights. Old enemies resurface and Blade will have to face one of her most challenging opponents-her mom.

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP23
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: Golden Bowl - EP1
programme.desc: Man’s Noodles is passed down to the current generation. Man Shui (Raymond Cho), Man Nin (Hugo Wong) and Man Sai (Mark Ma) have learned the craft from their father and opened their own noodle shops. However, three shops on the same street have resulted in destructive competition. Lung Kau (Mayanne Mak), Fok Siu-yuk (Ashley Chu) and Kam Chi (Kamen Kong) are their wives respectively. They often quarrel as they earnestly defend their husbands.

programme.title: The Runner - EP3
programme.desc: Web media editor Ho Ka-yan (Elaine Yiu) encounters track and field coach Yuen Nik (Joel Chan) as she is assigned the task of approaching the Windchasers Club and digging up scandalous dirt. Because of some past regrettable incident, Yuen Nik avoids socializing with other people. But he is getting closer and closer to Ka-yan as he repeatedly mingles with her. Kwok Bui-yee (Tiffany Lau), daughter of tycoon Kwok Wong-po (Ram Chiang), eagerly joins Windchasers as she has some ulterior motive.

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP29
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: Plain Love II - EP28
programme.desc: ‘Fong’s tea’ is regarded as the finest in the trade. However, due to downfall of the family, its successor Yau Wai (Lam Ka Tung) can only earn his living by farming. WAI has two best friends, Hon Ngau (Mak Cheung Ching) and Wing Chun (Li Ka Sing, Dickson). They even become sworn brothers, share both happiness and bitterness._x000D_The three of them work in a huge tea garden of Sung’s family. Wai meets Ngai Mui (Cheung Ho Yee, Maggie) again, a girl from highlands.

programme.title: Shades of Life - EP122
programme.desc: Ko Ba-dou (Yu Yang), a retired school principal with a deep love for traditional Chinese culture, values ​​family ethics and is highly respected by his family. His eldest son, Ko Ho-pan (Wu Nuoyan), a journalism graduate and magazine editor, is a prodigy who seeks to get to the bottom of things. On livelihood issues, he occasionally disagrees with his father, holding different views.

programme.title: Hello Missfortune - EP5
programme.desc: In a multidimensional domain, Poon Siu-yu (Erica Chan) enters the second dimension after her death in the first dimension, i.e. the mortal realm. She then joins Office of the Life Authority and becomes a novice "destiny administrator". Siu-yu has to keep a close watch on food courier Chan Pei-ho (Hubert Wu), who is in the mortal realm. Pei-ho earns a meager living regardless of the weather. But his family members just do not care about him.

programme.title: Pages Of Treasures - EP6
programme.desc: Bookshop staff FONG HOK MAN (Chun Pui) always believes that "knowledge is power". He tries hard to encourage his older son FONG SUM MING (Lai Yiu Cheung) and his younger son FONG SUM CHING (Suen Eric) to study more. Unfortunately, MING is not good at studying at all and he quits after secondary school. On the other hand, CHING is a very smart boy and MING works hard overseas to support CHING’s further studies on computer sciences in America.

programme.title: The Price Of Greed - EP19
programme.desc: Police Constable LUI TO (WONG CHUNG CHAK, BOSCO) is shocked to discover that TSU FUNG (CHAN KIN FUNG, SAMMUL), who has reportedly gone missing for a year, is already dead and that his body has been claimed by his girlfriend LAM PING (TSUI KATE TSZ SHAN). Then, suddenly and mysteriously, FUNG, who is believed to be dead, turns up again, which makes the enigma even more intriguing. The relationship between PING and FUNG is also put to the test amidst such confusion.

programme.title: 宝岛西米乐守护第182集
programme.desc: 热闹的台北太平老街上，少女春燕和母亲雅芬穿过拥挤的人群，来到生意兴隆、美军也来光顾的「宝岛西服店」，寻找失踪的父亲照清。照清曾在这里当过学徒，和老板梅树师是师兄弟，但因故未能出师…。春燕看著梅树与晓兰鹣鲽情深地经营「宝岛西服店」，这美好的景象让春燕想起父亲曾向自己承诺，未来若跟著师兄梅树出师后，自己的西服店也会正式挂牌营业，并收女儿春燕当全台第一位西装女徒弟，将西装技艺传承下去

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第420集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 热海恋歌第23集
programme.desc: 父母亲早逝的英雄，从小就住在西螺的大舅家。一次乡里冲突，英雄和换帖兄弟添财离家北上，进入温泉乡~北投，当起限时专送的机车小弟。在北投，他遇见今生唯一的挚爱秀秀。拥有天生音乐才华的他，最初学习各种乐器只是为了讨秀秀欢心，最后却因此成为名扬北投的「春风」那卡西乐团乐手。可惜两人纯真的恋情，却遭秀秀的养父所反对，英雄却不放弃；纵使在得知秀秀已与日本商人白原订婚之后，英雄仍不死心，继续穿梭在温泉乡崎岖的巷道与繁华的酒宴间，弹著为秀秀所谱写的未完成歌曲，无畏地向全世界宣誓，他要倾尽一生的光阴来爱秀秀…。在秀秀与白元的婚礼上，英雄冲到美川阁，想带秀秀远走高飞！毕竟深爱著英雄的秀秀，身著婚纱、不顾一切坐上他

programme.desc: 骆纯美出生在台南的下营，爸爸骆焕宗在下营是个出名的裁缝老师，经常举办服装秀，父亲也经营电影院，从小与父亲感情甚好的纯美，二人就如朋友一般，无话不说，从小就生活在「美的事物」的纯美，也间接地感染到美感，父亲对于纯美的未来从不设限，让她自由发挥，在父亲的支持下与鼓励下，便让纯美梦想要当一个「艺术家」。 高中联考时，家中生意失败，让一心想要念「艺术系」的纯美，放弃梦想，转念师专，因此展开了她的老师生涯。师专毕业的纯美，向孔子立誓自己一定要当一个好老师，但纯美用热情对待学生，把学生留下来课辅，却让其他老师嫌恶，要她不要太认真，让她对「老师」的这个职业，产生了疑问。 为了离家近，纯美调到台南的乡下小

programme.title: 大爱年度剧展-芳草碧连天第28集
programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第9集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第489集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 法譬如水第525集
programme.desc: 当灾难成为日常，纷乱的世界迫切需要人心的调和，携手共度难关。大爱电视特别推出《法譬如水—证严上人讲述水忏》，透过佛法智慧引领观众反思人心与环境的深层连结。证严上人以清凉法水涤除心垢，将经典智慧化为实践指南，让佛法不再遥不可及，而是化解当下困境的明灯。唯有人心净化，天地才会和谐。

programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第13集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 纯美时光第19集
programme.desc: 骆纯美出生在台南的下营，爸爸骆焕宗在下营是个出名的裁缝老师，经常举办服装秀，父亲也经营电影院，从小与父亲感情甚好的纯美，二人就如朋友一般，无话不说，从小就生活在「美的事物」的纯美，也间接地感染到美感，父亲对于纯美的未来从不设限，让她自由发挥，在父亲的支持下与鼓励下，便让纯美梦想要当一个「艺术家」。 高中联考时，家中生意失败，让一心想要念「艺术系」的纯美，放弃梦想，转念师专，因此展开了她的老师生涯。师专毕业的纯美，向孔子立誓自己一定要当一个好老师，但纯美用热情对待学生，把学生留下来课辅，却让其他老师嫌恶，要她不要太认真，让她对「老师」的这个职业，产生了疑问。 为了离家近，纯美调到台南的乡下小

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第56集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: TRY科学第47集
programme.desc: 你我的生活小问号，可能成就科学大发现。所以号召全民try科学，活化每个人潜在的科学基因。 生鸡蛋握掌心，为什么连壮汉都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎么打开没拉环的易开罐？ 科学基因不限男女老幼贫富贵贱，科学现象不分校园、街头、办公室或客厅，Try科学想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科学以放大生活中各种有趣现象为诱因，以主持人科学机智问答的闯关设计，透过科学MAN吸引眼球的科学实验与找答案的逻辑推理……让科学接地气，让科学活用在生活里。

programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 大爱学汉医第220集
programme.desc: 让世界看懂中医，打破中医的框架迷思，发挥预防重于治疗的优点，让台湾走向乐活社会。

programme.title: 人间菩提
programme.desc: 一年365天，一天15分钟， 证严上人以佛心应世事，结合台湾社会脉动、全球趋势，从后山看世界。

programme.title: 大爱年度剧展-芳草碧连天第30集
programme.desc: 这是台湾三代女性传承孝顺的历史缩影。 魏家三代女性的心路历程，从第一代阿罔，在艰困的环境中，没有失志，奋发面对生活的挑战，孝顺婆婆、支持丈夫及女儿，让大家都能好好活下去，与人为善，救贫治病，深受四邻亲友敬仰的精神里，影响著女儿高金英及孙女杏芬杏娟姊妹，他们传承阿妈的脚步，走过时代洪流，与家人彼此扶持，以孝顺回报阿妈和母亲。杏芬在美国听了「渡」的录音带把家人都度进慈济

programme.title: 大爱医生馆第6729集
programme.desc: 不断汲取新知，已是现代人必备的条件，对于人文精神的掌握，往往显得贫乏。大爱医生馆借由医师专业知识加上俯拾即是的美感经验与与回归人文思想的本怀，期望帮助忙碌的现代人多关心自己与周遭人的身心健康，为医疗节目注入生活化的素材。

programme.title: 台湾味道7第13集
programme.desc: 深入台湾各地乡野探寻珍宝美味与在地文化，内容扣人心弦、发人深省。

programme.title: 台湾味道8第1集
programme.desc: 以台湾这片土地上奋斗的小人物为主角的系列纪录片。这些升斗小民、寻常人家为追求他们的愿望、向往、志向、使命或执著，坚持著一种作为。这个作为，就是他们之所以活得精彩的故事，也是《台湾味道》探寻、撷取的影像题材、故事的基础。

programme.title: MIT台湾志第614集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 大陆寻奇第1927集
programme.desc: 大陆寻奇是台湾目前最社教节目之冠不惜巨资的大制作足迹踏遍各现代城市、穷乡僻壤，深入各民族村落，记录了外人难得一见的生活情况，以准确的地理、历史定位，用现代化思维，把中华文化忠实的呈现。 漫游在浩瀚中国的世外桃源，细赏湖光山色间的粉妆玉琢，带您跋山涉水游遍奇峰峻岭，让您看尽壮阔山河叹为观止。

programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第53集
programme.desc: 同名小说改编。青丘九尾狐族女君白浅（杨幂）为四海八荒第一绝色，化名司音拜入战神墨渊（赵又廷）门下，因而卷入天族与翼族之战。在墨渊封印东皇钟七万年后，白浅代师再次封印东皇钟而受伤，失去记忆与修为落入凡尘历劫，却因此变成凡人素素，与天族太子夜华（赵又廷）历经三生三世的情缘…

programme.title: MIT台湾志第789集
programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子第6季:第398集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活为蓝本的故事，其中一事一物均充满著1970年代的怀旧气息。故事发生的舞台是日本静冈县清水市，那是一个不折不扣的美丽港都，是个交通便利、渔产丰富、又与富士山为邻的好地方。故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子第5季:第344集
programme.desc: 故事的主角是小丸子及其家人和同学，故事内容涵盖了亲情、友谊等主题，以及一些生活中的小事情。这些故事中既有欢笑，也有泪水，让人回想起童年时的天真无邪。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第42集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 三生三世十里桃花第54集
programme.desc: 同名小说改编。青丘九尾狐族女君白浅（杨幂）为四海八荒第一绝色，化名司音拜入战神墨渊（赵又廷）门下，因而卷入天族与翼族之战。在墨渊封印东皇钟七万年后，白浅代师再次封印东皇钟而受伤，失去记忆与修为落入凡尘历劫，却因此变成凡人素素，与天族太子夜华（赵又廷）历经三生三世的情缘…

programme.title: 霹雳靖玄录第16集
programme.desc: 霹雳封魔妖氛起，靖匡逆鳞系五玑。 玄祸方兴殛心劫，录异鲲鯩纳传奇。 随著虚无的力量扩散，神秘的南域亦受影响，风涛十二楼、麒麟阁、一局通神、论剑山庄能人辈出，各显风采。同时，神秘的禁忌长城、死亡三角洲，隐藏著武林未知的暗潮，神秘的浩劫，轩昂五玑在列的参天鹿帻占云巾、琴狐，将如何引领风骚，揭开禁忌之秘？ 崭新剧情，侠影鸿篇，且看五玑论战，并鳞乱世，血谱一卷风云史。道锋龙首，仙影侠踪，共题两阕靖玄录。

programme.title: 台南好生活第14集
programme.desc: 结合深度走访与人文情怀，以在地人视角出发，深入走读旧城区，寻访巷弄特色；记录各行各业职人的百态，表现出城市文化中属于「人」的温度；透过现代文创为传统产业重塑价值，不仅传承更赋予新生。

programme.title: 护心第36集
programme.desc: 灵龙天曜怀著满心喜悦准备和广寒门掌门素影成亲，谁知素影另有图谋，她计划取龙鳞制一件龙鳞铠甲，为护她真正所爱之人不伤不死，却不想天曜拼死在最后一刻将凝聚巨大灵力的护心鳞打出，素影大怒，将天曜的不死之身肢解，封印于大江南北。护心鳞飞跃山河，落入了一心口缺失的弃婴雁回胸膛，填补了雁回心脏缺失，让她得以活命。十年后，流浪的雁回被辰星山掌门凌霄收养，纳入辰星山成为他的弟子。因识海未开，灵力全无，仍是一星弟子，因此被同门嘲笑。一次偶然的机会，触发了雁回心口护心鳞的力量，灵龙之火瞬间烧毁了锁妖塔的结界，塔内的妖族趁机逃跑。凌霄得知后将其赶出辰星山，雁回误解了师父，觉得道不同不相为谋，便潇洒下山去永州成找好朋

programme.title: 风车第1集
programme.desc: 颜教授与妻子雅淑挑李天下，一生引领多少学子走过人生历程，但是面对自己丧失爱孙的哀痛却始终走不出来。小卫，一个痴痴等待机会到荷兰寻母的快递男孩，生活中没有目标，只有靠飙车的刺激慰藉自己空虚的梦想渴望。小卫守著母亲从荷兰寄来的风车，颜教授与雅淑守著元元最爱的各式各样风车，因为这两端对风车的执爱，在一场意外中，因风车而结识。

programme.title: 红包第1集

programme.title: 公视早安新闻第43集
programme.desc: 《公视早安新闻》（Good Morning Taiwan, PTS）是公共电视文化事业基金会新闻部制播的晨间新闻节目，于2016年6月6日开播。本节目开播时，为国英双语节目，其中前半小时以国语播报、后半小时为以英语播报的《Good Morning Taiwan, PTS》。2017年7月31日起，公视早安新闻改为全程国语播报，而英语新闻改为周一至周五播出的《公视英语新闻》（《PTS English News》）。

programme.title: 公视手语新闻第31集

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2749集

programme.title: 台湾食堂第7集
programme.desc: 多元融合，煎煮炒炸，酸甜苦辣滋味丰富，是台菜特色。台菜也因体系庞杂，看得到外来「血缘」，以致若认真询问哪些菜才算正宗台菜，相信没有几个人能说的明白。台湾究竟有哪些值得推上国际的美食？什么是最能代表台湾的「台菜」？

programme.title: 在地旅行第7集

programme.title: 遇见祝福第24集

programme.title: 真情部落格第509集
programme.desc: 自2005年开播以来，《真情部落格》已访问数百位生命勇士。当这些勇士面对生命中的困难时，他们选择依靠对耶稣的信心，勇敢地克服挑战。这些可爱的基督徒愿意与大家分享他们生命中最黑暗、最脆弱的一面，目的是将来自天上的美好福分带给人们。每一个充满血泪的生命见证都是令人震撼的转变，带来最深刻的真实感。

programme.title: 福气人生第684集
programme.desc: 要拥有福气人生，可以透过聆听牧师们以台语分享圣经的真理，让你领受天国满满的福气与祝福。这些牧师们将以深入浅出的方式解释圣经，将其应用于当代生活，让你明白神的心意和计划。通过聆听台语讲道，你可以更深入地理解圣经的教导，并在日常生活中实践。这些讲道将提供实际的指引和智慧，帮助你在家庭、工作、人际关系等各个领域经历神的福气。聆听这样的讲道，你将能够领悟到属天的价值观和生活方式，学习依靠圣灵的带领，活出基督徒的身份和见证。这将使你能够更深入地体验神的爱和恩典，并将其传递给他人。

programme.title: kakudan时光机第9季:第93集
programme.desc: Kakudan为台湾原住民排湾语，「文化，惯习」的意思，希望可以从台湾原住民族隽永的文化，找到实践的道路。台湾原住民族在这块土地上已生活了八千年，祖先留下了珍贵的文化资产与族群智慧。惟因过去的历史面对不同时代的迁徙汉化与日治时期殖民政权的干扰，使得原住民传统文化的存续面临断层与式微的挑战。然而处于文化逐渐式微的困境，又面对长者生命的迅速凋零，我们如何抢救文化？如何教育下一代有正确的文化知识与视野？如何把传统说得更清楚？

programme.title: 大自然生趣第12集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第4季:第3集

programme.title: 旧货猎人-最赞买卖第4季:第5集
programme.desc: 在本集中，德鲁普里察回顾了他与英国优秀收藏家们的相遇，并让观众欣赏他们的惊人收藏品，其中包含充满传统游乐设施的露天游乐场、有著上千艘模型船的收藏、经典且丰富的各种摇滚乐纪念品、厉害且惊人的铁路物件等，让大家大饱眼福。

programme.title: 凯文哈特的肌肉车俱乐部第1季:第7集
programme.desc: 凯文为上次车展失败时自己失控的言行向史班克道歉，并表示俱乐部是一个团队，大家要互相依靠，又嘉许乔伊对俱乐部做的装饰、哈利新设计的标志和伯斯规划的活动。伯斯的野马又在路上抛锚，他找拉奇帮忙脱困，决定请拉奇帮忙整修、更换引擎，拉奇还帮他补上遗失的F字母。乔伊带著拉奇和哈力去看一辆他心心念念的68年奥斯摩比弯刀，车况不错、价格合里，于是杀价后买下。凯文带哈利和约翰到永恒车厂看他交由车厂改装的五辆老爷车。凯文考虑以后做改装车生意。约翰与哈利都在改装第二辆老爷车，有了第一次的经验，这次更有计划。两人去看约翰选定的内装颜色，又去取订制的车轮，观看车轮制作做过程。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 佛莱迪和璜前往历史小镇桑普特帮助毕尔斯父子档挽救经营不善的矿场，不过在现场亲眼观察后，佛莱迪和璜发现了真正的大问题。

programme.title: 翻新中古车-世界巡回第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龟 在全英国翻新了上百辆令人惊艳的中古车后，迈克布鲁尔和马克艾维斯普力斯利迎接新的挑战。他们即将展开环球巡回冒险，入手、修复、卖出世界上最经典的车子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden冲浪车。在这趟史诗级公路之旅中，迈克和艾维斯沉浸在各个国家的汽车文化中，结识不可思议的人物、参与精彩的活动并探寻当地的专业。最重要的是，他们使用翻新中古车的老经验来拯救每台车，打造可以卖出好价钱的好车

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第4季:第3集
programme.desc: 佛莱迪和璜第一次来到华盛顿州，要协助李维和好友柯瑞解决一个月只产出一盎司半黄金的问题。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第12季:第3集
programme.desc: 这次麦克要寻找1950年代末期生产的英国跑车MGA。他从经典车经销商手中找到一台结构札实的车，以低价成交后，立刻开回工作室请艾德著手翻新。

programme.title: 凯文哈特的肌肉车俱乐部第1季:第8集
programme.desc: 凯文和塑胶杯男孩的哥儿们，回顾成立俱乐部以来的活动：在直线加速赛中学到速度、在甩尾赛道上学到控制、向其他汽车俱乐部学习制定章程、参观汽车博物馆了解汽车风格、到汽车拍卖会上彰显自己对进入汽车俱乐部界的认真，最重要的是委托一流的造车厂师傅改造他们的车子。他们总算将俱乐部会所布置完善，也将改好的车子在户外场地一字排开，邀请相关人士来他们的第一届车展共襄盛举，见证他们的进步。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 自古以来，伐木一直是人类生活的重要产业，时至今日，仍是世界上最危险的工作之一。树越大，风险越高...报酬也越可观。在太平洋西北地区，伐木工杰瑞德道格拉斯带著团队，采伐世界上最巨大、最有价值的树种之一：北美桧木。但要把这些体积跟巴士一样大的巨木，从森林运送到市场一点也不容易。不仅需要高超的锯木功夫、规模庞大的机械设备，还要有在地表最严酷环境上工的勇气。

programme.desc: 艾德史塔福寻找并参与世界上最艰苦、最危险、最严苛的部落成年礼，探索这些古老习俗是否可能是社会和个人危机的解答。世界上有许多地方透过身体和精神的仪式，引导凝聚族群的人们。

programme.title: 恐龙化石挖宝人第2季:第1集
programme.desc: 在蒙大拿州地狱溪地层，克雷顿菲普斯与儿子路克挖掘去年路克发现的三角龙穴址，却一无所获，只能忍痛放弃。去年挖到的罕见侏儒暴龙有博物馆感兴趣，但是要求更清楚点数头骨数量，因此必须开始清理。克雷顿表妹牧场上，在极靠近州土地处发现一个暴龙穴址，经地籍调查员确认不在州土地上后，大家决定冒险开挖。在怀俄明州，麦克哈里斯受到暴龙史丹即将拍卖激励，决定将牛仔暴龙的头盖骨送去犹他州清理，以吸引买家青睐。今年麦克的搭档艾伦波伦雇请托莉帮忙寻找下一个挖掘点。艾伦想尽量找出最多的化石穴址，按难易度排序。他和托莉先找到一个三角龙穴址，但开挖难度太高。接著找到一处鸭嘴龙穴址，很有希望找到艾伦梦美以求的鸭嘴龙头骨。

programme.title: 绝地伐木勇士第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 自古以来，伐木一直是人类生活的重要产业，时至今日，仍是世界上最危险的工作之一。树越大，风险越高...报酬也越可观。在太平洋西北地区，伐木工杰瑞德道格拉斯带著团队，采伐世界上最巨大、最有价值的树种之一：北美桧木。但要把这些体积跟巴士一样大的巨木，从森林运送到市场一点也不容易。不仅需要高超的锯木功夫、规模庞大的机械设备，还要有在地表最严酷环境上工的勇气。

programme.title: 古董商大挑战第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 彤恩与薇琪替屋主罗瑞寻找能致敬工业革命的物品装饰壁炉，由彤恩成交。杰比与塔希替酒吧老板史莱寻找20世纪中期的餐具柜，杰比获得客户青睐。

programme.desc: 吉姆与温蒂坐拥占地七百多公顷的矿场，却面临要清算设备的窘境。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第15季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集的旧货猎人中，德鲁和堤伊造访三个别具特色的地点，寻找具有吸引力的收藏品。在华许摩托博物馆，德鲁发现了一辆令他爱不释手的玩具车，资深旧货商马克斯摩尔收藏的古董英式家具更是让他大开眼界，拜访比尔野生动物公园更是让两人有意想不到的收获。

programme.title: 翻新中古车-世界巡回第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 墨西哥越野金龟 在全英国翻新了上百辆令人惊艳的中古车后，迈克布鲁尔和马克艾维斯普力斯利迎接新的挑战。他们即将展开环球巡回冒险，入手、修复、卖出世界上最经典的车子，像是法拉利348、澳洲Holden冲浪车。在这趟史诗级公路之旅中，迈克和艾维斯沉浸在各个国家的汽车文化中，结识不可思议的人物、参与精彩的活动并探寻当地的专业。最重要的是，他们使用翻新中古车的老经验来拯救每台车，打造可以卖出好价钱的好车

programme.desc: 埃洛荻动完手术后，男友德安德烈竟不见踪影，两人一见面就吵架，德安德烈甚至脱口而出不愿意担任继父的角色；麦特秘密计划著要向肯西求婚，鬼祟的行径，加上雀儿喜在家没大没小的态度，反而让肯西内耗又伤神；珍妮佛与丹妮儿去酒吧放风，却遭到香泰尔不断来电打扰，引发一场大吵，珍妮佛不禁担忧起自己接下来该如何是好。

programme.title: 脚痛要人命-线上看诊第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界仿佛都静止下来了，但医学可不会停下脚步。尽管大家都待在家里与外界隔离，但脚痛起来简直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔离疼痛，幸好靠著线上看诊，足踝外科医师依然能与病患取得联系，检查患者的足部病症。葛兰患有先天性缺趾症，这让他的脚看起来就像龙虾的爪子，每踏出一步都让他痛不欲生，全身各个部位也都在为这样畸形的足部病症产生代偿，不仅髋部会歪斜，膝盖也会疼痛无比，布莱德医师建议可以进行足趾并趾化手术，让他重获外观正常的双足，全身重量也不会施压在单一位置之上。

programme.title: 脚痛要人命-线上看诊第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界仿佛都静止下来了，但医学可不会停下脚步。尽管大家都待在家里与外界隔离，但脚痛起来简直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔离疼痛，幸好靠著线上看诊，足踝外科医师依然能与病患取得联系，检查患者的足部病症。艾蜜莉天生罹患脊柱裂，小时候医生就断言她将无法行走、奔跑和跳跃，不过她仍在两岁时学会走路，渐渐跟上同龄孩子的脚步，但后来小脚趾又开始蜷缩到脚底下，每踏出一步都让她痛不欲生，艾波妮医师建议截除两只小脚趾，好让负重面恢复平衡。

programme.title: 到国外征婚去第1季:第6集

programme.title: 面子问题第1季:第1集

programme.title: 迷你屋大梦想第8季:第4集

programme.title: 超级大体型第2季:第4集
programme.desc: 在减肥外科普罗克特医生的协助下，病态性肥胖患者为自己的生命奋战。家庭关系、友谊都备受考验，唯有少数人会做出真正的改变，进行减重手术来开启新的人生道路。

programme.title: 星座情人第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 在这个资讯爆炸的时代想找到真爱可说是难如登天，不过有好几百万的人正风靡一种古老的方法，那就是占星术，因为有越来越多的人开始指望星座配对能帮自己找到毕生挚爱。占星师柯林、米雪儿与法兰切丝卡从每个星座里各挑出一位单身人士，并将他们配对成六对佳偶，展开一场前所未有的恋爱实验。在一个月亮周期内，众佳偶将努力培养感情，占星师同时从旁引导，为每对佳偶给予相处上的建议，这种以占星术配对的方法真能促成天作之合吗？

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第10集
programme.desc: 卡洛琳与亚利克喜获麟儿博文，史帝夫兴奋带著礼物上门探望，却意外惹怒卡洛琳。艾波与约翰协议离婚，约翰答应所有条件，唯独想把退休金留给自己的孩子。艾波却借题发挥，痛骂约翰是无情无义的混蛋，连前夫罗伊都看不下去，出手帮忙协调。麦特打算向肯西求婚，雀儿喜却在前一天突然消失，令麦特十分错愕不解。埃洛荻介绍德安德烈给家人认识，但由于德安德烈劣迹斑斑，亲友团对他展开猛烈炮火。

programme.title: 义式烹饪大赛第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 比赛的前四强要两两一队比赛，两队必须各自使用至少两种野猪部位做出两道主菜。

programme.title: 脚痛要人命-线上看诊第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界仿佛都静止下来了，但医学可不会停下脚步。尽管大家都待在家里与外界隔离，但脚痛起来简直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔离疼痛，幸好靠著线上看诊，足踝外科医师依然能与病患取得联系，检查患者的足部病症。葛兰患有先天性缺趾症，这让他的脚看起来就像龙虾的爪子，每踏出一步都让他痛不欲生，全身各个部位也都在为这样畸形的足部病症产生代偿，不仅髋部会歪斜，膝盖也会疼痛无比，布莱德医师建议可以进行足趾并趾化手术，让他重获外观正常的双足，全身重量也不会施压在单一位置之上。

programme.title: 脚痛要人命-线上看诊第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 新冠肺炎疫情肆虐全球，世界仿佛都静止下来了，但医学可不会停下脚步。尽管大家都待在家里与外界隔离，但脚痛起来简直要人命，患者更不可能得以隔离疼痛，幸好靠著线上看诊，足踝外科医师依然能与病患取得联系，检查患者的足部病症。艾蜜莉天生罹患脊柱裂，小时候医生就断言她将无法行走、奔跑和跳跃，不过她仍在两岁时学会走路，渐渐跟上同龄孩子的脚步，但后来小脚趾又开始蜷缩到脚底下，每踏出一步都让她痛不欲生，艾波妮医师建议截除两只小脚趾，好让负重面恢复平衡。

programme.title: 从里到外第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 两位主持人要帮普西拉和麦克夫妻翻修房子，范围包含前后院、厨房、书房、客厅与餐厅。然而随著拆除工程进行，暴露出许多意料之外的问题，也代表著额外花费。他们是否能克服一切，为麦克夫妻打造出理想房屋？

programme.title: 你、我和我的前任第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 亚利克跟卡洛琳正在做宝宝派对的准备，史帝夫突然出现在家门口。麦特找朋友来协助求婚计划，但雀儿喜却不见踪影。珍妮佛跟香泰尔的关系好转，大伙儿正在考虑要找律师厘清法律相关问题。德安德烈请埃洛荻来家里吃饭，两人讨论了未来走向并做出了决定。

programme.title: 到美国结婚去-寻爱再出击第1季:第14集
programme.desc: 八位曾参与《到美国结婚去》的单身男女，来到墨西哥土鲁母这座美丽天堂，再次出击寻找真爱。他们将与形形色色的单身人士配对，满怀希望踏上难忘的浪漫之旅，追寻属于自己的第二次幸福机会。

programme.title: 迷你屋大梦想第8季:第3集
programme.desc: 吉儿和和贾斯汀菲利普住在俄克拉荷马州里诺，育有两个小孩，吉儿提出想要住进迷你屋的想法，这样就不用大费周章清理维护，可以花更多时间和孩子家人相处。

programme.title: 迷你屋大梦想第8季:第4集
programme.desc: 因医学院训练的关系，苏菲需要经常搬到不同的地方，而她很想要一个属于自己的家，所以她决定盖一间4坪大的行动迷你屋。
